description: This Java class implements a validator for patient identifiers using the Luhn checksum algorithm. It extends from a base class and provides methods to compute check digits, validate identifiers, and retrieve validator properties.

classes.name: LuhnIdentifierValidator
classes.description: A validator class for patient identifiers based on the Luhn checksum algorithm, capable of generating and validating identifiers with check digits.

methods.name: getCheckDigit
methods.description: Calculates the check digit for a given identifier using the Luhn Algorithm.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the validator.

methods.name: getAllowedCharacters
methods.description: Returns the set of characters allowed in the identifier.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier
methods.description: Constructs a valid identifier by appending the check digit to the original identifier.
